bibliographic.title: Structural changes in Ti1-xAlxN coatings during turning: A XANES and EXAFS study of worn tools

affiliations.text: Nanostructured Materials, Dept. Physics, Chemistry and Biology (IFM), Linköping University, 581 83 Linköping, Sweden
MAX IV Laboratory, Lund University, SE-221 00 Lund, Sweden
Thin Film Physics, Dept. Physics, Chemistry and Biology (IFM), Linköping University, 581 83 Linköping, Sweden

bibliographic.abstract: Structural changes in Ti1-xAlxN coated tool inserts used for turning in 316L stainless steel were investigated by XANES, EXAFS, EDS, and STEM. For coarse-grained fcc-structured Ti1-xAlxN coatings, with 0≤x≤0.62, the XANES spectrum changes with Al-content. XANES Ti 1s line-scans across the rake face of the worn samples reveals that TiN-enriched domains have formed during turning in Ti0.47Al0.53N and Ti0.38Al0.62N samples as a result of spinodal decomposition. The XANES spectra reveal the locations on the tool in which the most TiN-rich domains have formed, indicating which part of the tool-chip contact area that experienced the highest temperature during turning. Changes in the pre-edge features in the XANES spectra reveal that structural changes occur also in the w-TiAlN phase in fine-grained Ti0.38Al0.62N during turning. EDS shows that Cr and Fe from the steel adhere to the tool rake face during machining. Cr 1s and Fe 1s XANES show that Cr is oxidized in the end of the contact length while the adhered Fe retains in the same fcc-structure as that of the 316L stainless steel.

samples.sample_description: Coarse-grained arc-deposited TiN coating on WC-Co insert, used for turning tests and XANES/EXAFS measurements.
Coarse-grained arc-deposited fcc-Ti0.77Al0.23N coating on WC-Co insert, used for turning tests and XANES/EXAFS measurements.
Coarse-grained arc-deposited fcc-Ti0.47Al0.53N coating on WC-Co insert, used for turning tests and XANES/EXAFS measurements.
Coarse-grained arc-deposited Ti0.38Al0.62N coating on WC-Co insert, deposited using a 63 mm diameter cathode, used for turning tests and XANES/EXAFS measurements.

Fine-grained arc-deposited Ti0.38Al0.62N coating on WC-Co insert containing a mixture of fcc and wurtzite phases, deposited using a 100 mm diameter cathode, used for turning tests and XANES measurements.
Magnetron sputtered single crystal TiN reference coating grown on MgO (111) substrate from a Ti target in Ar/N2 atmosphere.
Magnetron sputtered single crystal fcc-Ti0.35Al0.65N reference coating grown on MgO (001) substrate from a Ti0.35Al0.65 target in Ar/N2 atmosphere.
316L stainless steel reference sample measured at the Fe 1s and Cr 1s edges for comparison with adhered species on worn tool inserts.

datasets.dataset_description: Ti 1s XANES line-scans across the rake face of worn tool inserts and spectra of as-deposited coatings and magnetron sputtered reference coatings, collected in fluorescence yield mode with a 50 µm vertical beam size.

Ti 1s EXAFS spectra measured at selected positions on as-deposited and worn arc-deposited coatings and MS reference coatings, used to extract interatomic distances for Ti-N, Ti-Ti, and Ti-Al scattering paths.
Cr 1s XANES line-scans across the rake face of worn TiN and Ti0.47Al0.53N coated inserts and a 316L steel reference, to characterize the oxidation state of adhered Cr species.
Fe 1s XANES line-scans across the rake face of worn TiN and Ti0.47Al0.53N coated inserts and a 316L steel reference, to characterize the structure of adhered Fe species.

Grazing incidence and Bragg-Brentano XRD of as-deposited coatings using Cu Kα radiation on a Bruker D8 Advance, used to determine phase content and extract lattice parameters from the fcc-111 diffraction peak.

SEM imaging and EDS elemental mapping of the rake face of worn tool inserts in a Leo 1550 Gemini instrument, used to characterize wear morphology and identify adhered Fe, Cr, O, and other species from the workpiece.
datasets.measurement_technique: scanning electron microscopy/energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy

datasets.dataset_description: Elemental contrast HAADF-STEM imaging of FIB-prepared cross-section lamellas from the crater region of worn Ti0.47Al0.53N and Ti0.38Al0.62N coated inserts, used to visualize nm-scale compositional domains from spinodal decomposition.
